docstring: A candidate whose required simulation gate failed on an unfilled reference-model hook re-enters Step 4 on the same bytes once a different accepted model exists; the AI backup task names the model before the first re-gate.
fix_action: The producer report names the measured model; the resume consumer plans the existing same-bytes regate when a different accepted model exists; the backup task carries the path as a conditional advisory.
benchmark_result_change: NONE; a route with a required Step 4 can now reach acceptance, and no score is claimed
